narr: On January 25, a low pressure system moved east through the Ohio River Valley. This brought one to three inches of rainfall and gusty winds through central Kentucky. Isolated flooding and tree damage resulted.
ev: Multiple county roads were under water, including portions of Woodbury Loop and Brooklyn Chapel Road.
lsr: MULTIPLE COUNTY ROADS UNDER WATER, INCLUDING PORTIONS OF WOODBURY LOOP AND BROOKLYN CHAPEL ROAD.
